topic: From Prompt to Product: How 7 AI Agents Build a Video

scenes.title: Scene 1: The Prompt
scenes.narration: Every AgentReel video begins with a single prompt: vision, topic, and audience.
scenes.caption: Every AgentReel video begins with a single prompt: vision, topic, and audience.

scenes.title: Scene 2: The 7 AI Agents Workflow
scenes.narration: In our pipeline, seven specialized agents coordinate: Planner sets the plan, Researcher checks facts, Scriptwriter writes the story, Storyboarder designs shots, Asset Generator creates visuals, Editor builds the edit, and Critic verifies quality.
scenes.caption: In our pipeline, seven specialized agents coordinate: Planner, Researcher, Scriptwriter, Storyboarder, Asset Generator, Editor, and Critic.

scenes.title: Scene 3: Multi-Track Timeline Assembly
scenes.narration: Next, multiple media tracks assemble in lockstep: visual cards, voiceover audio, and burned SubRip captions.
scenes.caption: Multiple media tracks assemble in lockstep: visual cards, voiceover audio, and SubRip captions.

scenes.title: Scene 4: Critic QA HUD & Repair Loop
scenes.narration: Before delivery, the Critic inspects eighteen quality rules. Any caption violation triggers an automated repair loop.
scenes.caption: Critic inspects 18 rules. Any caption violation triggers an automated repair loop.

scenes.title: Scene 5: Final Video Reveal & Call to Action
scenes.narration: The result is a broadcast-ready vertical video, built by AI agents. Come and build with us.
scenes.caption: The result is a broadcast-ready vertical video, built by AI agents. Come and build with us.
